summary: Break-glass changes need two people, the emergency override works, and PIM Manager is tidier.

new.title: Break-glass changes need two SuperAdmins
new.text: Changing Break-glass accounts now raises a request with your justification. A different SuperAdmin approves or rejects it within 72 hours.
new.action: Make sure each environment has at least two SuperAdmins to change Break-glass accounts in PIM Manager.

new.title: Emergency override works
new.text: The emergency override card explains what happens and shows whether a passphrase is set. It switches off approval on chosen groups; nothing is granted.
new.action: To use the emergency override, set a passphrase once per environment with the provided operator script.

new.title: Departments & owners has its own page
new.text: Departments & owners is now a page under Access instead of being buried in Settings.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: All records has a compact list with a filter and full-width table, and two unused settings were removed.
